name: AI teammates that do the work
caption: AI teammates that do the work. Grok Bot signs into your tools and comes back with finished work. Early beta, needs an eligible plan. One tool, explained. More new tools: link in bio.
alt: AI teammates that do the work. Grok Bot signs into your tools and comes back with finished work.

What it does: Bots are AI teammates that sign in to your tools and use them like you do. How it works: each Bot gets its own cloud computer and keeps working when your laptop is closed. Good to know: it is in early beta and needs an eligible plan.
